newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Dec trade surplus at 872 mln rgt - MMS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Dec trade surplus at 872 mln rgt - MMS.

text.p: The Malaysian trade balance was at a surplus of 872 million ringgit in December 1996, the Singapore-based research house MMS International said on Tuesday.
In its market note, MMS said the data was released by the Statistics Department.
The department releases the closely-watched monthly figure only through national news agency, Bernama, which has yet to release the data.
The surplus contrasted with a deficit of 526.4 million ringgit in November 1996.
Later, MMS said the figure was picked up from another wire agency.
